taskExecutionPolicy.codingStyle: Defensive programming is forbidden (user directive 2026-10-01), hard requirement for gpt-family models. Deliberately designed fail-closed behaviour is NOT defensive programming: contract/evidence gates, explicit unknown + reconcile, real budget reservation, explicit schema/version rejection, boundary validation of genuine external input. Test: if removing the code leaves a real reachable input that fails silently, keep it; otherwise delete it.
